title: 第一卷 南域篇 第9章 万物皆为剑第一卷 南域篇 第10章 问道借剑
slug: 剑问九州第1286章星域虫潮
content_zh:
“有形剑和无形剑吗？”柳灵似有所悟。
“十年前无名剑侠身负一剑，柳下问道，是为御剑流。”谢玄说，“而还有一种人，如我，修的是无形剑，也就是气剑。”
“原来如此。”柳灵点头。
“元方，明日随我练剑，一招一式，必谨记在心。”谢玄先吩咐元方，然后又对白泽说：“明日一天，你去后山悬泉瀑布，傍晚时分回来告诉我，你所见为何。”
“那柳剑，我是否不需要了？”白泽问。
“习剑之人，怎可无剑？”谢玄淡然一笑，“在你学会无形剑之前，剑不可弃。”
“好嘞！”白泽满口答应，然后摸了摸肚子，“晚饭吃了吗？我肚子饿得咕咕叫啦！”
“啊，这个给你！”彩云哒哒地跑到白泽年前，牵起他的右手，将一颗绿色的水果硬糖塞到他手里，看着和她差不多高的男孩，说：“村子里的孩子都有，老神仙给了我两颗，分你一颗！”
“谢谢小姐姐~”白泽咧嘴一笑，看着彩云糯米团子一样白乎乎的小脸，伸手捏了捏，将水果糖丢进嘴里，囫囵嚼了嚼，“真甜！”
“嗯！”彩云笑得眉眼弯弯，蹦蹦跳跳地跑开，“那明天见啦，我回家吃饭，拜拜！”用力挥手。
“拜拜~”白泽说。
一夜无话，第二天。
“师傅，我出门啦！”白泽吃完早饭，拎着柳剑冲出房门，直奔后山而去。
“嗯，中午不用回来了，自己解决吃食。”谢玄坐在院子里和柳灵喝茶，问他：“你会下围棋吗？”
“老小子惶恐，不知为何物。”柳灵说。
“这样吧，”谢玄见陈元方出门，说：“我先教元方练剑，然后我教你下棋，如何？”
“悉听尊便。”柳灵点头。
谢玄喝了口酒，将葫芦放在古槐树下的石桌上，站了起来，示意元方上前：“来，以后每日功课，右手举剑，与肩平齐，双腿扎马步，一个时辰。”
“是！”元方没有疑问，照做起来。
“好，一个时辰后，我教你道门三十六天罡剑法，能领悟多少，全凭造化。”谢玄说，拎起酒壶，悬在腰间，对柳灵说：“你随我去渡河找一方平整青石，做棋盘。然后挑些黑白卵石，做棋子。”

“好。”柳灵跟着谢玄出了庭院柴门，走了十余丈，终究还是忍不住，问道：“敢问道尊，昨晚小友那一剑，当真一无是处？”
“天资绝顶，奈何道邪。”谢玄八字评论，笑着摇头。
“那道尊以为，元方此子，资质如何？”柳灵又问。
“无奇，尚可。”谢玄说。
“道尊以为，元方修行之路，能抵达何处？”柳灵想了想，询问。
“早些日子，白泽问过我类似的问题。”谢玄说，拄杖而立，道：“他问我，天纵奇才和平庸之辈，何者可达天道顶峰。”
“道尊如何解答？”柳灵心中一动，眼神微亮，追问道。
“重要吗？”谢玄说，悠悠叹气，“天道十九，又有谁，真能确定，自己就能抓住那一线天机，以证天道呢？每个人心中，对道的执念都不尽相同，这个问题，任凭他们二人去闯就好了，我们又何必在意？”
“我明白了。”柳灵如释重负。
傍晚时分，谢玄和柳灵正在村长家院子里下围棋，晚风轻送茶香，两人你一子我一子，将半个棋盘布满。
白泽踩着晚霞，吹着口哨吹来柴门，见元方还是一招一式地练剑，汗水已经将他全身打湿，双腿双手都在隐隐发抖，还在咬牙坚持。
“回来了？”谢玄听见口哨声停了，问白泽：“后山所见，为何？”
“悬泉瀑布，如银似龙。”白泽回答。
“嗯。”谢玄点头，说：“明日去后山再看，傍晚时分回来告诉我，所见为何。”
“好吧。”白泽一听师傅语气，就知道这个答案不是他想要的。
“元方，你也歇一歇，明日再练。”谢玄又说，“清洗一翻，准备吃晚饭吧。”
“好！”元方停下，将柳剑插在地上，喘了一大口气，汗如流水，眼睛被咸涩的汗水沾染，生疼。
“白泽！”篱笆那头，彩云对他招手，抱着五张葱花饼，“娘亲说让我给你们，刚出锅，可香啦！”
她垫着脚尖，将葱花饼从篱笆上递了过来。
白泽跑了过去，接过刚出锅的大饼，闻了闻，赞不绝口：“真香！彩云娘亲的手艺真好，以后彩云长大了，肯定像娘亲一样心灵手巧。”

“哼，那当然！”彩云被夸得心花怒放，说：“那等我长大，你还在村子里吗？我听村长爷爷说你和老神仙云游天下，不知道什么时候就会离开柳庄呢。”
说着，小丫头有些伤感起来。
content_en:
"Is there a visible sword or an invisible sword?" Liu Ling seemed to have some realization.
"Ten years ago, the unknown swordsman carried a sword, Liu Xia asked, and it was for the sword-controlling style." Xie Xuan said, "And there is another kind of person, like me, who cultivates invisible swords, which are air swords."
"That's it." Liu Ling nodded.
"Yuan Fang, follow me to practice sword practice tomorrow. Make sure to keep every move in mind." Xie Xuan first ordered Yuan Fang, and then said to Bai Ze: "Tomorrow, you go to the Xuanquan Waterfall in the back mountain. Come back in the evening and tell me what you saw."
"Do I no longer need Liu Jian?" Bai Ze asked.
"How can a swordsman be without a sword?" Xie Xuan smiled lightly, "Until you learn the invisible sword, you must not abandon the sword."
"Okay!" Bai Ze agreed, then touched his stomach, "Have you had dinner? My stomach is growling with hunger!"
"Ah, this is for you!" Caiyun ran over to Bai Zeqian, took his right hand, and stuffed a green fruit candy into his hand. Looking at the boy who was about the same height as her, she said, "There are all the children in the village. The old god gave me two, and I will give you one!"
"Thank you, Miss~" Bai Ze grinned, looked at Caiyun's little face as white as a glutinous rice dumpling, reached out and pinched it, threw the fruit candy into his mouth, and chewed it wholeheartedly, "It's so sweet!"
"Yeah!" Caiyun smiled with crooked eyebrows and ran away jumping, "I'll see you tomorrow, I'll go home for dinner, bye!" waved vigorously.
"Bye~" Bai Ze said.
One night without words, the next day.
"Master, I'm going out!" Bai Ze finished breakfast, rushed out of the room with Liu Jian, and headed straight for the back mountain.
"Well, you don't have to come back at noon. You can eat by yourself." Xie Xuan sat in the yard drinking tea with Liu Ling and asked him, "Can you play Go?"
"The old boy is scared and doesn't know why." Liu Ling said.
"Let's do this," Xie Xuan saw Chen Yuanfang going out and said, "I'll teach Yuan Fang how to practice swordsmanship first, and then I'll teach you how to play chess. How about that?"
"It's up to you." Liu Ling nodded.
Xie Xuan took a sip of wine, placed the gourd on the stone table under the ancient locust tree, stood up, and signaled Yuan Fang to come forward: "Come, from now on, for daily homework, raise the sword in your right hand, level with the shoulder, and straddle the horse with your legs for an hour."
"Yes!" Yuan Fang had no doubts and followed the instructions.
"Okay, in an hour, I will teach you the Dao Sect's Thirty-Six Tiangang Sword Techniques. How much you can understand depends entirely on luck." Xie Xuan said, picked up the wine bottle, hung it on his waist, and said to Liu Ling: "Follow me to cross the river to find a flat bluestone to make a chessboard. Then pick some black and white pebbles to make chess pieces."
"Okay." Liu Ling followed Xie Xuan out of the firewood gate of the courtyard and walked for more than ten feet. Finally, she couldn't help but asked, "Dare you dare to ask me, my dear friend, that sword you made last night was really useless?"
"Excellent talent, but evil ways." Xie Xuan commented, shaking his head with a smile.
"What do you think, the Taoist Master, is Yuan Fang's qualifications?" Liu Ling asked again.
"No surprise, it's acceptable." Xie Xuan said.
"Where do you think, Taoist Master, Yuan Fang can reach on his path of cultivation?" Liu Ling thought for a while and asked.
"Earlier, Bai Ze asked me a similar question." Xie Xuan said, standing on his staff, "He asked me, between the geniuses and mediocre people, who can reach the peak of heaven."
"How does Taoist Master give the answer?" Liu Ling's heart moved, her eyes brightened, and she asked.
"Is it important?" Xie Xuan said, sighing leisurely, "Of the Nineteenth Heavenly Dao, who can really be sure that he can seize the secret of heaven and prove the Heavenly Dao? Everyone has different obsessions with the Dao in their hearts. We can just let the two of them pursue this problem. Why should we care?"
"I understand." Liu Ling felt relieved.
In the evening, Xie Xuan and Liu Ling were playing Go in the courtyard of the village chief's house. The evening breeze carried the scent of tea. They filled half of the chessboard with one piece and one piece.
Bai Ze stepped on the sunset and whistled to Chaimen. He saw that Yuan Fang was still practicing his sword moves one by one, and he was already wet with sweat.My whole body was wet, my legs and hands were trembling, and I was still gritting my teeth and persisting.
"Come back?" Xie Xuan heard the whistle stop and asked Bai Ze: "What did you see in the back mountain?"
"The hanging springs and waterfalls are as silver as dragons." Bai Ze replied.
"Yes." Xie Xuan nodded and said, "Go to the back mountain tomorrow and have a look. Come back in the evening and tell me what you saw."
"Okay." Bai Ze knew as soon as he heard the master's tone that this answer was not what he wanted.
"Yuan Fang, you should take a rest and practice again tomorrow." Xie Xuan added, "Clean up and get ready for dinner."
"Okay!" Yuan Fang stopped, stuck the willow sword on the ground, took a deep breath, sweated like water, and his eyes were stained by the salty sweat and hurt.
"Bai Ze!" Caiyun waved to him from the other side of the fence, holding five slices of green onion pancakes, "My mother asked me to give them to you. They are freshly cooked and delicious!"
She stood on her tiptoes and handed the green onion pancake over the fence.
Bai Ze ran over, took the big cake that had just come out of the pan, smelled it, and was full of praise: "It smells so good! Mother Caiyun's craftsmanship is so good. When Caiyun grows up, she will definitely be as ingenious as mother."
"Humph, of course!" Caiyun was elated by the praise and said, "Then when I grow up, will you still be in the village? I heard from the village chief that you and the old god traveled around the world, and I don't know when you will leave Liuzhuang."
As she said this, the little girl became a little sad.
